allowed_changes: require exactly three consecutive positive completed close-to-close moves: close[T-1]>close[T-2]>close[T-3]>close[T-4]
candidate additionally requires close[T-1]>SMA(200), while the single matched control removes only this SMA condition
buy at the next real daily open with initial stop entry open minus 2.00 times frozen T-1 ATR(14)

after each completed holding close, including the entry close, trail at highest completed close minus 2.00 times current ATR(14), never lower the prior stop, and make the update effective next asset session
use no profit target, no maximum holding period and no evaluation-end forced sale; mark any final open position to market
standalone 100% sleeve runs plus one fixed one-third-per-asset combined run, matched no-SMA controls, CNY cash and 0.05% per-fill adverse-slippage stress

controls.cash: C-CASH-COMBINED uses the existing CashYieldCNY demand-deposit model over the identical evaluation window
controls.matched_no_sma: C-CONSECUTIVE-NO-SMA keeps the same three-rise entry, ATR trailing stop, allocation, marking and cost rules but removes only close[T-1]>SMA(200)

expected_outputs: gold, Nasdaq, S&P 500 and fixed one-third combined candidate metrics
asset-matched three-rise controls without SMA200, CNY cash control and 0.05% per-fill adverse-slippage stress
closed round-trip count, win rate, average net trade return and profit factor
stop exits, gap-stop exits, time exits, final open positions and holding-session distribution
cross-calendar marking, maximum gross, minimum cash and target fingerprints
portfolio CSV for every candidate, control and stress path
dataset hash, run authorization receipt and SHA-256 result artifact manifest
mechanical PASS/FAIL decision covering every preregistered gate
follow_up_policy: After any formal 006 metric is viewed, do not change the three-rise definition, SMA200 filter, ATR14 lookback, 2.00 ATR stop, next-open entry, stop execution order, no-time-exit rule, allocation, assets, fee, slippage or cross-calendar marking inside this trial. Any alternative rise count, trend period, stop distance, profit target, maximum hold, extra factor or sizing rule is a new trial.
forbidden_changes: reading execution-session high, low or close before the opening buy decision
allowing the entry-session low to trigger the newly opened position's stop
testing or selecting among two, three or four consecutive rises or adding a minimum cumulative rise threshold
testing any moving-average lookback other than SMA200 or any ATR lookback/multiple other than ATR14 and 2.00
lowering a live trailing stop, using a close below stop instead of the frozen gap/intraday execution order, or rewriting gaps to fill at the stop
adding a take-profit, maximum holding period or evaluation-end forced liquidation
using synthetic OHLC or omitting carried value for a held asset on its non-session date
asset-specific parameters, pyramiding, dynamic sizing or dropping a weak gold, Nasdaq or S&P 500 component
adding RSI, MACD, volume, calendar, volatility regime, shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or negative weights
changing the user-specified fee or hiding the preregistered slippage stress
representing index OHLC execution as directly investable product evidence
hypothesis: Three consecutive completed daily gains contain short-horizon time-series trend persistence. Requiring the prior close above SMA200 should improve the risk-adjusted performance of a next-open long position managed only by a nondecreasing two-ATR daily trailing stop across gold, Nasdaq and S&P 500 versus the otherwise identical three-rise rule without SMA200.
pass_fail_gates: at least two of three standalone assets have full-period CAGR above the CNY cash control
at least two of three standalone assets have full-period Sharpe >0
each standalone asset has at least 65 completed round trips
fixed one-third combined CAGR >= CNY cash CAGR +2.00 percentage points
fixed one-third combined Sharpe > C-CONSECUTIVE-NO-SMA-COMBINED Sharpe
fixed one-third combined average net closed-round-trip return >0 and profit factor >=1.10
at least 4/5 fixed time folds have combined Sharpe >0
combined 2020+ CAGR and 2022+ CAGR are each greater than full-window CNY cash CAGR
with 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, combined CAGR remains above CNY cash CAGR and Sharpe >0.50

maximum gross <=100%, minimum end-of-day cash >=0, every completed trade holds at least 2 observed asset sessions, time-forced exits =0, every completed trade exits through the stop, and final open positions <=3
selection_metric: No within-family selection. There is exactly one three-rise plus SMA200 candidate. All standalone paths, the fixed one-third combined path, matched no-SMA controls and execution stress are reported; PASS requires every preregistered gate.

shared_rules.entry: buy current real daily open after exactly three consecutive completed positive close-to-close moves; candidate also requires previous close>SMA200
shared_rules.exit: initial two-ATR stop; then nondecreasing highest-completed-close minus current two-ATR trailing stop, gap fills at next open and other touches fill at stop
shared_rules.trailing_update_effective: next asset session after each completed close, including entry-session close
